More than likely Planaria Worms, a bit like this? These are Planaria!

They are completely harmless, unless you really don't want the thought of them being in your tank/see then every now and again! Whenever I stir up my sand, there's a few that pop up that become snacks for my Guppies in my 60g! I also think that my young Dojo loach digs for them (digging constantly, then sitting up and obviously chewing at something).

They tend to explode when you're overfeeding/have a lot of waste sitting around in your tank, at least from what I know, but they generally just hang out in the substrate unless your stir it up/vacuum. Your Betta might even snack on them if he sees them, basically free little snacks :)
